action.objective: Verify Rh4# as the forced mate-in-1 against Black's king on h7
action.rationale: Broad depth-1 search scored g4h4 at 99999 (mate band) as the suggested move. Rh4 gives check along the h-file; Black's king on h7 has no escape since g7 is covered and the bishop on f7, pawn f6 restrict squares. Single-candidate verification will confirm mate and pass the commit gate.
